description: Register the start of an agent run with its execution ID, trigger and associated projects so subsequent activity can be correlated.

agentId.description: Identifier of the mapping agent claiming the scope.

executionId.description: Execution record.id from begin_agent_execution when associating this call with an existing execution; not a session or project ID.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated retry key. Reuse the same key and identical payload only to retry the same mutation; use a new key for a new action.

occurredAt.description: Timestamp of the execution event being recorded.

parentExecutionId.description: Existing execution that initiated this child execution.

projectIds.description: Owned projects associated with this execution event.

requestMetadata.description: Bounded fields describing the request that started this execution.

threadId.description: Identifier of the agent conversation associated with this execution.

trigger.description: Event or request that started the recorded execution.

name: begin_agent_execution
title: Begin agent execution
